meta.title: Solutions — the websites, systems and AI we build
meta.description: Custom and WordPress websites, online stores, e-learning platforms, customer portals, ERP integrations, automation and AI assistants.

title: Solutions
lead: The kinds of websites, systems and AI solutions we design and build. Every solution is made for the specific business.

items.title: AI assistants
items.text: Assistants that answer customers and staff from your documents, prices and rules — on your website, in your online store or inside the company.

items.title: Automation and integrations
items.text: Enquiries, documents and orders that move from one program to another on their own. With artificial intelligence where reading and understanding are needed.

items.title: Custom and WordPress websites
items.text: Hand-coded websites for top speed and WordPress websites with a custom theme for a quick start. Either way you update the content without a developer.

items.title: Online stores
items.text: Catalogue, basket, payment and delivery, connected to your stock and accounting.

items.title: Internal systems and ERP
items.text: Small ERP systems for stock, orders and customers, admin panels and reports that replace spreadsheets.

items.title: Portals and e-learning platforms
items.text: A secure sign-in for customers — requests, payments, documents — and platforms with courses, lessons, certificates and an AI mentor that helps learners.

note: We publish information about specific projects only with our clients' consent.

technology.title: Technology
technology.lead: We choose the technology to fit the task, not the other way round. We work with established tools that are maintained for the long term and easy to hire for.

groups.title: AI models
groups.reason: We work with the leading language models through their APIs. When data must not leave the company, document search runs on your own server.

groups.title: Front end
groups.reason: Pages are sent ready from the server, so the website loads fast and is found by search engines. TypeScript catches errors before they reach the visitor.

groups.title: Back end
groups.reason: Node.js — for applications coded to order. WordPress — with themes and plugins written by us, when the site has to be ready quickly and your team needs to update it themselves.

groups.title: Data
groups.reason: Established open-source databases: no licence fees and no dependence on a single vendor. Your data stays portable.

groups.title: Infrastructure
groups.reason: The system runs the same on our machines and on the server. Updates are released automatically and can be rolled back.
